maps.name: Amberfield Downs
maps.subtitle: Golden downs on the west road

props.text: East: Lanternvale, over the hill. West: Amberfield Cross, the Amber Bridge and, a long day on, Brightwater. Someone has carved underneath: THE GATE IS HAYBRIGHT'S. BE NICE TO THE DOG.
A golden tree, humming loudly.
A shepherd's cairn on the brow of the downs. From up here the whole of Amberfield lies gold to the west, the river a silver thread, the windmill turning. Every shepherd who passes adds a stone.
HAYBRIGHT FARM. Barley, beans, forty sheep, one dog and Bruna. Gnolls: please use the other road.
A scarecrow in a patched coat and a hat with a sunflower in the band. There is a crow on its arm, which is not a good advert.
The Reeve's Hall: the biggest farmhouse on the Downs, which isn't saying much. A slate by the door reads TODAY: oil (none). Tomorrow: oil (hopefully).

NOTICES. Lost: one queen bee, answers to nothing — see Old Hob. Wanted: the DITCHWATER GANG (highwaymen), by order of the Reeve — see Constable Pip. Harvest-Home postponed until the lanes are lit. Found: one sock.
A neat cottage with a vegetable patch laid out in ranks like soldiers. A heron is carved over the door.
A lane lantern, dry as a biscuit. The oil's been stolen.
A lane lantern, dry as a biscuit. The oil's been stolen.
A lane lantern, dry as a biscuit. The oil's been stolen.
A lane lantern, dry as a biscuit. The oil's been stolen.
WAXLEY'S HONEY. Mind the bees. The bees mind you.
The tallest stone, carved with a crowned figure holding up a little flame.
A cask of lamp oil, stencilled PELL'S MILL.
North: nothing good (gnolls). South: Turnbull's turnips. West: Brightwater.
A cask of lamp oil, stencilled PELL'S MILL.
A cask of lamp oil, stencilled PELL'S MILL.
A sinkhole, neatly round, right where a row of turnips used to be. Something has been digging from below.
MUDPAW WORKINGS. Please do not fall in. (The sign is upside down. The Mudpaw read it from below.)
West: Brightwater, the river town. East: Amberfield Cross and the Downs.

regions.name: Amberfield Downs
regions.text: Amberfield Downs — gold to the horizon, and not a lamp lit on any lane.

regions.name: Haybright Farm
regions.text: Haybright Farm. Somewhere a dog is snoring.

regions.name: Amberfield Cross
regions.text: Amberfield Cross — a well, a mill, a reeve, and a great many opinions.

regions.name: The King's Ring
regions.text: The King's Ring. Seven grey stones stand in the gold, leaning together like old men sharing a secret.
regions.successText: The grass on the mound north of the stones grows in a seam, straight as a ruler — over a door.
regions.failText: The stones keep their secret. The wind hums through them, and nothing more.

regions.name: Shepherd's Lookout
regions.text: Shepherd's Lookout. The whole of the Downs lies below, gold to the river and gold beyond it.
regions.successText: One stone of the cairn is cleaner than the rest. Someone takes it out, often.

regions.name: Duskmane Warcamp
regions.text: The Duskmane warcamp: hide tents, bone totems, and the smell of somebody else's lamp oil.

regions.name: Mudpaw Quarry
regions.text: The Mudpaw workings. Little lights bob in the tunnel mouth: candles, on helmets, on moles.

regions.name: Aldwin's Watch
regions.text: Aldwin's Watch, the old king's tower. Someone has hung washing from the arrow slits.

regions.name: Amber Bridge
regions.text: The Amber Bridge. The river under it is the colour of weak tea and twice as cheerful.

quests.name: The Ember Road
quests.summary: The Heart Lantern showed ash drifting down from the north. Elder Maru sends you west over Amberfield Downs, where the lamp oil is vanishing into gnoll carts, and on to the archive in Brightwater.

stages.description: Take the west road out of Lanternvale to Amberfield Downs.
Find the Reeve of Amberfield at Amberfield Cross.
Ambush the Duskmane oil caravan on the track north of the Amber Bridge.
Take the caravan boss's tally-stick to Ser Corlan, the cottage with the heron over the door.
Cross the river to the Duskmane warcamp and break it: defeat Warchief Skarra Duskmane.
Bring Skarra's scorched letter to Reeve Hester.
Bring word to Archivist Penhallow in Brightwater.

quests.name: Lamps Out on the Downs
quests.summary: Tamsin Pell's last three casks of lamp oil were stolen off the carts. Find them and chalk her mill-mark on them so her carters can bring them home.

stages.description: Find Pell's three stolen casks and chalk her mark on each.
Tell Tamsin Pell her casks are marked.

quests.name: Biscuit's Bell
quests.summary: The Ditchwater Gang took Hedda Haybright's cart, and with it the brass bell she calls old Biscuit in with.

stages.description: Recover Biscuit's brass bell from the Ditchwater Gang at Aldwin's Watch.
Bring the bell back to Hedda Haybright.

quests.name: Feathers and Fury
quests.summary: Plains hawks have grown bold on the Downs, and old Redwing has taken a lamb a year for twenty years. Thin them out for Old Ida.

stages.description: Thin out the plains hawks on the Downs: the flock on the southern downs, the one over the north wheat and the Lookout's.
Tell Old Ida her lambs are safe.

quests.name: The Queen Has Left the Hive
quests.summary: Old Hob's best queen has swarmed into a golden tree by Shepherd's Lookout. Bring her home, slow and kind.

stages.description: Coax Old Hob's swarm out of the golden tree by Shepherd's Lookout.
Tell Old Hob his queen is home.

quests.name: The Ditchwater Gang
quests.summary: Jory Ditchwater's highwaymen have been stopping carts on the south road and have holed up in Aldwin's Watch. Constable Pip has deputised you, with a button.

stages.description: Deal with the Ditchwater Gang at Aldwin's Watch, however you see fit.
Report to Constable Pip at the Amber Bridge.

quests.name: Holes in the Barley
quests.summary: The Mudpaw tunnelers of the old quarry have started digging under Wat Turnbull's fields. Sort them out — however you like.

stages.description: Go to the Mudpaw quarry and settle the matter of the tunnels.
Tell Wat Turnbull how it went.

quests.name: A Peace Offering
quests.summary: Mother Delve of the Mudpaw wants to make peace with Wat Turnbull the Mudpaw way: with a stone.

stages.description: Take Mother Delve's peace geode to Wat Turnbull.

quests.name: The Scarecrow Who Walked
quests.summary: Tam Haybright swears the scarecrow in the east field walks at night and eats honey cake. Tam is right about one of those things.

stages.description: Investigate the scarecrow in Haybright's east field.

objectives.text: Find out what's in the scarecrow

stages.description: Decide what happens to the scarecrow's secret.
Tell Tam what you found.

quests.name: The Twelfth Banner
quests.summary: Ser Corlan Hale rode north with the Heronguard twelve years ago, one of eleven who came home. The Duskmane stole the pennant he carried. Bring it back.

stages.description: Recover Ser Corlan's heron pennant from Skarra's trophy chest in the Duskmane warcamp.
Return the pennant to Ser Corlan.

quests.name: Light the Lanes
quests.summary: With the oil coming home, Reeve Hester wants the four lane lanterns of Amberfield Cross lit, so Harvest-Home can begin.

stages.description: Fill and light the four lane lanterns of Amberfield Cross.
Tell Reeve Hester the lanes are lit.

quests.name: The King Under the Hill
quests.summary: Something under the King's Ring has woken the old king who lies there. Old Ida asks you to go down into the barrow and put it back to sleep.

stages.description: Find the hidden door into the barrow beneath the King's Ring.
Descend into the Barrow of King Aldwin and lay the king to rest.
Return to Old Ida.
